issues.message: Files fetched by commit may not create refs/main; offline load by repo name must be tested on the host (R2 E2, INFERRED).

No run-long dcgm-exporter start/stop stage and no scripts/s2_dcgm_scraper.py invocation is compiled, so a run has no in-run producer for gate.s2_telemetry_sources.parse_dcgm_scrapes. Why no clean stage: the exporter digest exists only in scripts/vast_exporter_control.sh:18 (no exporter role in gate.s2_runtime.IMAGE_ROLES, so the inventory cannot pin or pre-stage it); its start depends on per-process safety state a static argv cannot carry (host-engine and :9400 listener refusal :35-46, mktemp owner token and label :47-49, $$-suffixed name and --cidfile :16, :128-131); its only stop is the same process's EXIT trap with owner-verified removal (:55-73, :114-127), so no standalone stop stage exists; the script is a fixed 14-sample probe (:143-160), not run-long; the scraper is a foreground loop whose interval, duration and timeout are required inputs with no default; and this bootstrap plan holds no unit runs to wrap (units run from gate.s2_executor's plan via scripts/s2_run_units.py, and stages here run one at a time). Needed: an exporter image role, a start/stop split of the control script and executor-plan wiring.
